payload.title: A consensus-promoted finding stays OPEN after its plan merges: finding_closure.default_detectors registers only the drift origin, the closure pass completes as detector_unregistered, and plan_origin mints no Closes trailer for an F-origin plan
evidence: aria-kernel/aria_kernel/finding_closure.py:258-266 (an origin with no detector records detector_unregistered and completes the pass with the finding left open)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/plan_origin.py:185-205 (the commit contract carries a Closes trailer only for an ORPHAN origin; an F origin is trailerless)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/finding_promotion.py:280-291 (the promoted record is stamped ai_consensus:judgment_pipeline and carries rule= and finding_fingerprint= facts a detector could re-run)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/plan_synthesizer.py:680-681 (an OPEN F finding remains a plan candidate; status is judged by the slot policy)
aria-kernel/tests/test_finding_closure_on_merge.py:325-329 (the test pins that an origin without a detector stays OPEN; no test names the consensus origin)
payload.rule_violated: CLAUDE.md Review Finding Traceability: a merged fix must resolve the finding it closes; finding_closure's own contract is that the finding's origin detector re-runs at the merge commit.
payload.notes: A consensus-promoted finding is planned from the F lane and its PR merges. implementation_reconciler asks close_merged_plan_finding with default_detectors(); the origin ai_consensus:judgment_pipeline has no detector, so the pass records detector_unregistered, marks the merge's closure complete and the plan is skipped from then on. The finding stays OPEN with its fix on main and remains a plan candidate, and no Closes trailer can close it because F-origin commits use the trailerless types. Close condition: Register a detector keyed by finding_subject.CONSENSUS_ORIGIN that re-runs the originating adapter rule at merge_sha using the rule= and finding_fingerprint= facts, returning absent, reproduces or unverifiable. Test: a merged plan for a consensus-promoted finding ends RESOLVED and is not re-offered by scan_f_findings (red today); a test fails if an origin that can start a plan has no registered detector. Plan row: F3.8 and F3.9 (not started). Verified at origin/main d716541239.
